cards.mood: The piece opens with a sparse, contemplative atmosphere that mirrors internal questioning, maintaining a low-energy tension through the verses.
cards.vocal: A single Male vocalist delivers the performance with a rich, soulful baritone timbre that carries a slight rasp, adding texture and emotional weight.
cards.palette: A melancholic piano motif serves as the harmonic backbone, present from the very first second and continuing through to the fade-out, anchoring the song's emotional core.
